target_customer: Software companies and developers who need to extract data from documents such as invoices, receipts and IDs
problem: Developers building accounting, expense and KYC software need reliable document parsing but lack the AI capacity to build it. Mindee provides APIs and trainable models.
business_model: Usage-based API plus custom AI work for large customers

founders.name: Jonathan Grandperrin
founders.background_notes: YC page and VentureBeat name him as the founder and CEO with no background given. A Latka summary lists other co-founders but sources conflict, so they are not recorded.

competitors.name: Rossum
competitors.what: Startup for AI document data extraction

competitors.name: Veryfi
competitors.what: Receipt and invoice OCR API and mobile SDK, founded 2017

technical_complexity.rationale: Building accurate deep learning document parsers across formats and languages in 2018 to 2020 required real ML engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Trained models and customer integrations help, but big cloud vendors and several startups offered similar OCR APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: VentureBeat in October 2021 named these as competitors; Mindee remained independent and active through 2026.

market_need_then: Documents are everywhere and software builders wanted to automate accounting, AP, expense and KYC workflows; in 2021 over 50 software companies used the API in production per VentureBeat.

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer friendly: process documents at scale without engineering hassles

branding.community_and_virality: G2 4.8 of 5 and Capterra 4.9 of 5 ratings reported on its site

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct short name with developer-facing positioning and strong review ratings, but no coverage of the brand itself or its meaning.

outcome_analysis: Mindee, founded in Paris in 2018, raised a seed in 2019 and a $14M Series A in October 2021 led by GGV Capital, and says it processed over 1 billion pages in 2024. Its developer-first API and self-serve trial supported growth, while competition from cloud giants and LLM based extraction is a continuing risk. Competitor blogs claim a 2024 shift to custom OCR, which Mindee does not confirm.
notes: The 2019 seed amount is unknown here: one tracker says about $2M, a search summary of Mindee's own about page says $3M, so the amount is left null. A $7M Series A II in March 2023 appears only on CB Insights and Seedtable and is unverified, so it is not recorded. Total raised ranges from 16M to 37M across aggregators. A Latka interview (November 2021) reports about 70 customers, but only via a search summary. The pivot claim comes from competitor blogs only. Veryfi source is undated; Rossum and Google are named in the October 2021 article, about seven months after the batch. Outcome search found no acquisition or layoffs.
